title: This Computer Does 1.7 Quintillion Calculations Every Second

scenes.text: This computer does 1.7 quintillion calculations per second.
It's called El Capitan, and it's the fastest ever benchmarked.
That's 1.742 exaflops. A quintillion is a one with eighteen zeros.
It has more than eleven thousand compute nodes.
It sits at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in California.

description:
This computer does 1.7 quintillion calculations per second.
El Capitan, at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, reached 1.742 exaflops and was ranked the world's fastest supercomputer in November 2024.
What would you ask a computer this fast? Comment below.
first_comment: El Capitan beat its predecessor's peak by more than 20 times. What problem would you give it?
